name: remove-moot-docs-drift-managed-asset-bridge-allowlist
title: Remove the now-moot .codex/hooks bridge allowlist that masks the docs-drift managed-asset check
description: B-a7b0 added the docs-drift managed-asset contradiction check (CLAUDE.md 'do not create X' claims about a framework-generated asset). To avoid self-blocking before its sibling story B-94ae fixed the real CLAUDE.md wording, B-a7b0 seeded DOCS_DRIFT_MANAGED_ASSET_ALLOWLIST (packages/main/src/handlers/validate-docs-drift.ts lines ~176-188) with two BRIDGE entries — '.codex/hooks' and '.codex/settings.json' — each carrying the inline reason 'B-94ae will fix this CLAUDE.md wording; allowlisted so the gate does not self-block until then'. B-94ae has now merged (the real CLAUDE.md no longer forbids those paths), so the bridge is (1) dead config and (2) actively harmful: it PERMANENTLY masks the exact contradiction class the check was built to catch — if anyone re-introduces '不要创建 .codex/hooks' the gate would silently allow it. This was surfaced by the read-only combination review of the B-94ae + B-a7b0 pair on main and is VERIFIED safe to remove: running checkManagedAssetContradiction against the real current CLAUDE.md with an EMPTY allowlist returns 0 contradictions (proving removal does not false-fail the real doc). Outcome: empty DOCS_DRIFT_MANAGED_ASSET_ALLOWLIST (seed it empty like DOCS_DRIFT_PATH_ALLOWLIST, preserving the seam + comment so a future genuine pending claim can be added with a reason), and update the one regression-smoke assertion that currently relies on the DEFAULT allowlist suppressing '.codex/hooks' so it injects an explicit allowlist instead — keeping the seam proven without a permanent real entry. This is a data + test change only: the gate LOGIC (checkManagedAssetContradiction, the GENERATED_MANAGED_ASSET_KINDS set, the path-normalization) is NOT modified. Scope: the two allowlist entries + the corresponding smoke assertion only.
